summary: CLI command routing and execution — entry point for `find`, `gs`, `index`, `consumers`, and `kb`. Key pattern: runGs calls ensureKeeper before the cache load (keeps the index fresh for uncommitted edits) while runConsumers loads the cache directly with no keeper (pure read for capture hooks); the choice turns on whether the command needs live freshness. runGs also loads the co-change sidecar itself and passes it into handleGetStructure — reader-side, because handleGetStructure cannot reach disk. parseQueryArgs is a flat switch over every flag any subcommand accepts, so a flag added for one command is silently accepted by all of them; removing a command means removing its flags here too or they linger as dead accepted input.
